scope: Read-only CPU/source audit. No model experiment, source change, job restart or per-motion fitting.
question: Does recon inherently require standard adult SMPL-X, making G1 template necessarily wrong?
answer: No. Official reconstruction config for terrain and sitting explicitly selects g1_smplx. G1-proportioned SMPL-X is an upstream reconstruction body template, distinct from G1 robot trajectories.
direct_evidence: Official configs/recon_4dhoi/loco_smplx.yaml human_model.body_model=g1_smplx; file describes terrain and sitting reconstruction.
Official grail/models/g1_smplx_human.py generates a humanoid SMPL-X mesh using a baked G1-proportioned v_template, zero betas, unchanged recon trans, and no post-hoc human_data.scale.
Official postprocessing/postprocess.py uses the configured human model to put first-frame minimum body vertex on z=0, then offsets human/object; recon files do not save a per-record template tag.
Current grail_source.body_model_factory mirrors the official baked v_template/shapedirs=0/posedirs*reference_scale model. Current source path uses recon/*.pkl, not robot/*.pkl.
independent_limitations: Official main is not proof of exact pipeline revision used for every released file. HF pinned data revision was last modified 2026-09-06; some stair records retain human scale .7633275 and no predicted_body_height.
Existing TEMPLATE_AUDIT compares two model hypotheses by initial body minimum z; this supports but does not prove per-record template identity or body-terrain alignment.
Mesh/FK consistency proves internal export agreement, not source reconstruction accuracy.
Original synthetic RGB video is not the released 3D reconstruction or a certified 3D ground truth. Need compare the exact same sequence/frame and measure mesh/terrain contacts.
Current trainable gate checks body template/native assets/static object/negative terrain minimum but does not check full-sequence foot support or body-terrain penetration.
recommendation: No confirmed template/scale bug or independent source evidence requires abandoning the current preprocessing. Resume the existing immutable export if the paired scene-geometry review confirms no coordinate error. Treat outputs as reconstruction-derived candidate data, not physics-validated GT. Require whole-sequence foot/terrain support and penetration QC before adding GRAIL to training. Do not switch to standard SMPL-X or add per-frame floor snapping solely to fit a screenshot.

official_source_references.evidence: step5_filter_hoi_result: post_process_hoi_result runs before cp original src_mesh/* to mesh_dir; copy can overwrite scaled model.obj

chair_scale_hypothesis_review.initial_hypothesis: post_process exports obj_scale-baked model.obj, retarget converts it to USD, so multiplying released USD by obj_scale again might double scale.
chair_scale_hypothesis_review.status: Not established; paired numeric evidence supports current scale=.8 policy.
chair_scale_hypothesis_review.pipeline_counterevidence: recon_4dhoi.step5 calls post_process_hoi_result and then copies original src_mesh/* into mesh_dir, overwriting the scaled model.obj. Therefore postprocess output alone is not proof of final USD bake.
chair_scale_hypothesis_review.conclusion: Do not remove obj_scale based on the postprocess comment. At this paired example, applying the raw .8 scale naturally restores the asset ground datum; removing it introduces 10.2cm negative ground extent.
chair_scale_hypothesis_review.limitation: No original source OBJ independent vertex checksum is available in current local download, so this is code-chain plus geometry evidence, not universal byte-level proof.

current_job_blocking_evidence: None confirmed in this source/template/scale audit; paired scene geometry is audited separately.
revised_claim: The source-template contract is strongly supported by official reconstruction code and numeric examples, but per-record release provenance and whole-sequence physical quality remain unverified.
